# Test-period dates with severe delays (generated by `scripts/list_severe_dates.py`)

Severe = > 45 min late or cancelled. Test period Apr–Jul 2025, never used for training or tuning. Forecast made **6 h ahead**. The flight data is a ~1% sample, so 'what happened' covers only the sampled departures in that hour.

**All 350 test hours with at least one severe sampled departure, by what the tool said 6 h earlier:** RED 156 · AMBER 112 · GREEN 82.

**How to use:** in the dashboard pick the airport, set **Now** to the date and hour in the 3rd column, choose the target hour (+6 h), and press Check.
